purpose: Controlled definition and statistical-validation metadata for NFL FIDOS analytics metrics; contains no claimed NFL performance results.

records.numerator_definition: plays satisfying the declared success rule
records.interpretation_guard: Report rule version, sample size, and situation filters.

records.numerator_definition: eligible plays at or above the configured explosive threshold
records.denominator_definition: eligible plays with known play type and result
records.interpretation_guard: Never compare rates across different thresholds without normalization.

records.numerator_definition: eligible dropbacks with a credited pressure event
records.interpretation_guard: Separate pressure opportunity from sack opportunity and preserve credit policy.

records.numerator_definition: credited tackle opportunities recorded as misses
records.interpretation_guard: Pair with role, snap, and opportunity context before player comparisons.

records.numerator_definition: eligible third downs converting the line to gain
records.interpretation_guard: Declare penalty, turnover, and no-play treatment.

records.numerator_definition: eligible red-zone trips reaching the declared scoring outcome
records.interpretation_guard: Show touchdown, field goal, turnover, and empty-trip outcomes separately.

records.denominator_definition: eligible plays with valid pre- and post-play states
records.interpretation_guard: Model version, state space, and garbage-time policy are mandatory.

records.numerator_definition: eligible third downs converting the line to gain
records.interpretation_guard: Distance buckets must accompany aggregate rates.

records.numerator_definition: eligible forward pass attempts recorded as completed
records.interpretation_guard: Report exclusions and do not treat completion rate as pass value alone.

records.numerator_definition: total rushing yards on eligible rushing attempts
records.interpretation_guard: Show success and explosive splits alongside the mean.

records.numerator_definition: credited sacks on eligible opponent dropbacks
records.interpretation_guard: Report pressure rate separately and preserve sack-credit policy.

records.numerator_definition: kicking plays producing a start at or beyond the declared field-position threshold
records.interpretation_guard: Declare touchback, return, penalty, and weather exclusions.
